slides.texte_overlay:
quiet signs someone is
drawn to you

they point their feet at you

in a group, people's feet usually point towards the person they're most interested in. it's a small, unconscious signal most people never consciously notice.

they remember what you said

they bring up a small detail from a conversation weeks ago. we remember tiny things about people we pay close attention to, without even trying to do it.

they love your stories

people are drawn to someone who always has something surprising to share, and stories keep them close. people stay near the ones who make every conversation more interesting.
slides.texte_sophia:
they love your stories

people always want to hear my stories now. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a strange myth or a fact, and conversations never run out of life.

slides.texte_overlay:
they find small excuses

they ask questions they could easily answer alone, just to start a chat. little excuses to talk are often a quiet sign that someone wants you near them.

they linger

when everyone else leaves, they stay a few more minutes. not wanting a conversation to end is one of the most honest signs of real, genuine interest in you.
